from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(path, old, new):
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text()
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: replacement count {count}, want 1")
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))


replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/autoresume/codex_wake_transaction.go",
    '''\t\tcandidate, problem := readWakeTOML(path, entry.Name())
\t\tif problem != "" {
\t\t\treturn "", false, fmt.Errorf("wake automation candidate is not valid: %s", problem)
\t\t}
\t\tmatches = append(matches, candidate.ID)
''',
    '''\t\tcandidate, problem := readWakeTOML(path, entry.Name())
\t\tif problem != "" {
\t\t\treturn "", false, fmt.Errorf("wake automation candidate is not valid: %s", problem)
\t\t}
\t\tif candidate.TargetThreadID != wakeThreadID {
\t\t\treturn "", false, fmt.Errorf("wake automation candidate target changed during inventory: %s", candidate.ID)
\t\t}
\t\tmatches = append(matches, candidate.ID)
''',
)

replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/forward_only_semantic.go",
    '''\t\tswitch {
\t\tcase arm.kind == forwardOnlyOldTransport && markers&forwardOnlyOldWait != 0:
\t\t\toldSinks = mergeForwardOnlySemanticSet(oldSinks, sinks)
\t\tcase arm.kind == forwardOnlyCurrentTransport && markers&forwardOnlyCurrentWait != 0:
\t\t\tcurrentSinks = mergeForwardOnlySemanticSet(currentSinks, sinks)
\t\t}
''',
    '''\t\tif arm.kind&forwardOnlyOldTransport != 0 && markers&forwardOnlyOldWait != 0 {
\t\t\toldSinks = mergeForwardOnlySemanticSet(oldSinks, sinks)
\t\t}
\t\tif arm.kind&forwardOnlyCurrentTransport != 0 && markers&forwardOnlyCurrentWait != 0 {
\t\t\tcurrentSinks = mergeForwardOnlySemanticSet(currentSinks, sinks)
\t\t}
''',
)
replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/forward_only_semantic.go",
    '''\t\tif arm.kind != forwardOnlyCurrentTransport {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
''',
    '''\t\tif arm.kind&forwardOnlyCurrentTransport == 0 {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
''',
)
replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/forward_only_semantic.go",
    '''func forwardOnlySemanticSameObjectOldWaitRewrite(pkg *forwardOnlySemanticPackage, node ast.Node) bool {
\twrites := make(map[string]uint8)
\tast.Inspect(node, func(current ast.Node) bool {
\t\tassignment, ok := current.(*ast.AssignStmt)
\t\tif ok {
\t\t\tforwardOnlySemanticRecordRewriteAssignment(pkg, writes, assignment)
\t\t}
\t\treturn true
\t})
\treturn forwardOnlySemanticHasOldWaitRewrite(writes)
}
''',
    '''func forwardOnlySemanticSameObjectOldWaitRewrite(pkg *forwardOnlySemanticPackage, node ast.Node) bool {
\twrites := make(map[string]uint8)
\tconstructed := false
\tast.Inspect(node, func(current ast.Node) bool {
\t\tswitch typed := current.(type) {
\t\tcase *ast.AssignStmt:
\t\t\tforwardOnlySemanticRecordRewriteAssignment(pkg, writes, typed)
\t\tcase *ast.CompositeLit:
\t\t\tif forwardOnlySemanticWaitInputKind(pkg, typed) == forwardOnlyOldTransport {
\t\t\t\tconstructed = true
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t\treturn true
\t})
\treturn constructed || forwardOnlySemanticHasOldWaitRewrite(writes)
}
''',
)

replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/forward_only_semantic_contract.go",
    '''\tcase *ast.CallExpr:
\t\tidentifier, ok := forwardOnlyUnparen(typed.Fun).(*ast.Ident)
\t\tif !ok || identifier.Name != "len" || len(typed.Args) != 1 {
\t\t\treturn ""
\t\t}
\t\treturn forwardOnlySemanticObjectBase(typed.Args[0])
''',
    '''\tcase *ast.CallExpr:
\t\tidentifier, ok := forwardOnlyUnparen(typed.Fun).(*ast.Ident)
\t\tif !ok || identifier.Name != "len" || len(typed.Args) != 1 {
\t\t\treturn ""
\t\t}
\t\targument := forwardOnlyUnparen(typed.Args[0])
\t\tfor {
\t\t\tselector, ok := argument.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
\t\t\tif !ok {
\t\t\t\tbreak
\t\t\t}
\t\t\targument = forwardOnlyUnparen(selector.X)
\t\t}
\t\treturn forwardOnlySemanticObjectBase(argument)
''',
)

replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/quality_surface.go",
    '''\tfor _, token := range check.forbiddenTokens {
\t\tif !strings.Contains(text, token) {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tviolations = append(violations, Violation{
\t\t\tRule: "quality-wiring", Path: check.path, Line: 1, Column: 1,
\t\t\tMessage: "forbidden quality-gate wiring is present: " + token,
\t\t})
\t}
''',
    '''\tforbidden, err := qualityWiringForbiddenCalls(check, data)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\tfor _, call := range forbidden {
\t\tviolations = append(violations, Violation{
\t\t\tRule: "quality-wiring", Path: check.path, Line: 1, Column: 1,
\t\t\tMessage: "forbidden quality-gate wiring is present: " + call,
\t\t})
\t}
''',
)
marker = '''func qualityWiringOrderViolations(check qualityWiringCheck, data []byte) ([]Violation, error) {\n'''
helper = '''func qualityWiringForbiddenCalls(check qualityWiringCheck, data []byte) ([]string, error) {
\tif len(check.forbiddenTokens) == 0 {
\t\treturn nil, nil
\t}
\tif !strings.HasSuffix(check.path, ".go") {
\t\tvar found []string
\t\ttext := string(data)
\t\tfor _, value := range check.forbiddenTokens {
\t\t\tif strings.Contains(text, value) {
\t\t\t\tfound = append(found, value)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t\treturn found, nil
\t}
\tset := token.NewFileSet()
\tfile, err := parser.ParseFile(set, check.path, data, 0)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\tfound := false
\tast.Inspect(file, func(node ast.Node) bool {
\t\tcall, ok := node.(*ast.CallExpr)
\t\tif !ok {
\t\t\treturn true
\t\t}
\t\tselector, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
\t\tif !ok || selector.Sel.Name != "Check" {
\t\t\treturn true
\t\t}
\t\tpkg, ok := selector.X.(*ast.Ident)
\t\tif ok && pkg.Name == "harnesslint" {
\t\t\tfound = true
\t\t}
\t\treturn true
\t})
\tif found {
\t\treturn []string{"harnesslint.Check"}, nil
\t}
\treturn nil, nil
}

'''
replace_once("glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/quality_surface.go", marker, helper + marker)

\tif !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
''',
    '''\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(path)

\t\treturn &PublicationGuardHookDefect{Hook: publicationGuardBindingName, Path: path, Defect: PublicationGuardBindingInvalid}
\t}
\ttarget := string(data[:lineEnd])
\tif !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
''',
)

replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/workflow/reviewer_boundary.go",
    '''\t\tvar round reviewBlobRound
\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &round); err != nil {
\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf("reviewed blob ledgerを読めません: %w", err)
\t\t}
\t\tif round.Version != reviewedBlobsVersion {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
''',
    '''\t\traw := []byte(line)
\t\tversion, err := reviewedBlobRecordVersion(raw)
\t\tif err != nil {
\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf("reviewed blob ledgerを読めません: %w", err)
\t\t}
\t\tif version != reviewedBlobsVersion {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tvar round reviewBlobRound
\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &round); err != nil {
\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf("reviewed blob ledgerを読めません: %w", err)
\t\t}
''',
)
replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/workflow/reviewer_boundary.go",
    '''\tvar previous reviewBlobRound
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &previous); err != nil {
\t\treturn fmt.Errorf("前review roundのblob記録を読めません: %w", err)
\t}
\tif previous.Version != reviewedBlobsVersion {
\t\treturn nil
\t}
''',
    '''\tversion, err := reviewedBlobRecordVersion(raw)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn fmt.Errorf("前review roundのblob記録を読めません: %w", err)
\t}
\tif version != reviewedBlobsVersion {
\t\treturn nil
\t}
\tvar previous reviewBlobRound
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &previous); err != nil {
\t\treturn fmt.Errorf("前review roundのblob記録を読めません: %w", err)
\t}
''',
)
marker = '''func (w *Workflow) loadReviewedBlobRounds() ([]reviewBlobRound, error) {\n'''
helper = '''func reviewedBlobRecordVersion(raw []byte) (int, error) {
\tvar envelope struct {
\t\tVersion int `json:"version"`
\t}
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err != nil {
\t\treturn 0, err
\t}
\treturn envelope.Version, nil
}

'''
replace_once("glm-worker/internal/workflow/reviewer_boundary.go", marker, helper + marker)

p = Path("glm-worker/internal/workflow/reviewer_boundary_schema_test.go")

text = text.replace(
    '''\t\t`{"version":999,"review_number":4,"files":[]}`,\n''',
    '''\t\t`{"version":999,"review_number":4,"files":{}}`,\n''',
    1,
)
insert = '''
func TestPromoteLastReviewBlobsSkipsFutureIncompatibleShape(t *testing.T) {
\tw := newReviewedBoundarySchemaWorkflow(t, "promotion-future-shape")
\trecord := `{"version":999,"review_number":1,"files":{"future":"shape"}}`
\tif err := os.WriteFile(w.state.Path(lastReviewBlobsFile), []byte(record), 0o600); err != nil {
\t\tt.Fatal(err)
\t}
\tif err := w.promoteLastReviewBlobs(2); err != nil {
\t\tt.Fatal(err)
\t}
\trounds, err := w.loadReviewedBlobRounds()
\tif err != nil {
\t\tt.Fatal(err)
\t}
\tif len(rounds) != 0 {
\t\tt.Fatalf("future incompatible round was promoted: %#v", rounds)
\t}
}

'''
anchor = '''func newReviewedBoundarySchemaWorkflow(t *testing.T, repoHash string) *Workflow {\n'''
if text.count(anchor) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("reviewer schema anchor mismatch")
p.write_text(text.replace(anchor, insert + anchor, 1))

path = "scripts/manage-pull-hook.sh"
p = Path(path)
text = p.read_text()
old = '''install_lock_dir="$common_dir/codex-worker-orchestrator/hooks-install.lock"
mkdir -p "${install_lock_dir%/*}"
if ! mkdir "$install_lock_dir" 2>/dev/null; then
\tprintf 'git hook: another installer owns hook activation: %s\\n' "$install_lock_dir" >&2
\texit 1
fi
lock_owned=1
release_install_lock() {
\tif [ "$lock_owned" -eq 1 ]; then
\t\trmdir "$install_lock_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
\t\tlock_owned=0
\tfi
}
trap 'release_install_lock' EXIT HUP INT TERM
'''
new = '''install_lock_path="$common_dir/codex-worker-orchestrator/hooks-install.lock"
install_lock_candidate="$install_lock_path.candidate.$$"
install_lock_stale="$install_lock_path.stale.$$"
mkdir -p "${install_lock_path%/*}"
lock_owned=0
release_install_lock() {
\tif [ "$lock_owned" -eq 1 ]; then
\t\tif [ -f "$install_lock_path" ] && [ ! -L "$install_lock_path" ] && [ "$(cat "$install_lock_path" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$$" ]; then
\t\t\trm -f "$install_lock_path"
\t\tfi
\t\tlock_owned=0
\tfi
}
acquire_install_lock() {
\tumask 077
\tprintf '%s\\n' "$$" >"$install_lock_candidate"
\tif ln "$install_lock_candidate" "$install_lock_path" 2>/dev/null; then
\t\trm -f "$install_lock_candidate"
\t\tlock_owned=1
\t\treturn 0
\tfi
\trm -f "$install_lock_candidate"
\tif [ -L "$install_lock_path" ] || [ ! -f "$install_lock_path" ]; then
\t\tprintf 'git hook: hook activation lock is not a regular file: %s\\n' "$install_lock_path" >&2
\t\treturn 1
\tfi
\towner_pid=$(cat "$install_lock_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
\tcase "$owner_pid" in
\t'' | *[!0-9]*)
\t\tprintf 'git hook: hook activation lock owner is invalid: %s\\n' "$install_lock_path" >&2
\t\treturn 1
\t\t;;
\tesac
\tif kill -0 "$owner_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
\t\tprintf 'git hook: another installer owns hook activation: %s\\n' "$install_lock_path" >&2
\t\treturn 1
\tfi
\tif ! mv "$install_lock_path" "$install_lock_stale" 2>/dev/null; then
\t\tprintf 'git hook: another installer owns hook activation: %s\\n' "$install_lock_path" >&2
\t\treturn 1
\tfi
\trm -f "$install_lock_stale"
\tprintf '%s\\n' "$$" >"$install_lock_candidate"
\tif ! ln "$install_lock_candidate" "$install_lock_path" 2>/dev/null; then
\t\trm -f "$install_lock_candidate"
\t\tprintf 'git hook: another installer owns hook activation: %s\\n' "$install_lock_path" >&2
\t\treturn 1
\tfi
\trm -f "$install_lock_candidate"
\tlock_owned=1
\treturn 0
}
if ! acquire_install_lock; then
\texit 1
fi
trap 'release_install_lock' EXIT
trap 'release_install_lock; exit 129' HUP
trap 'release_install_lock; exit 130' INT
trap 'release_install_lock; exit 143' TERM
'''
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("hook lock block mismatch")
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
text = text.replace(
    '''initial_hooks_path_present=$hooks_path_present
initial_hooks_path=$hooks_path
''',
    '''initial_hooks_path_present=$hooks_path_present
initial_hooks_path=$hooks_path
hooks_path_written=0
''',
    1,
)
text = text.replace(
    '''\tif [ "$initial_hooks_path_present" -eq 1 ]; then
\t\tif ! git -C "$repo_root" config --local core.hooksPath "$initial_hooks_path"; then
\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to restore previous core.hooksPath' >&2
\t\t\treturn 1
\t\tfi
\telse
\t\tgit -C "$repo_root" config --local --unset-all core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
\t\tif git -C "$repo_root" config --local --get-all core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1; then
\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to restore absent core.hooksPath baseline' >&2
\t\t\treturn 1
\t\tfi
\tfi
''',
    '''\tif [ "$hooks_path_written" -eq 1 ]; then
\t\tcurrent_hooks_path=
\t\tif current_hooks_path=$(git -C "$repo_root" config --local --get-all core.hooksPath); then
\t\t\tcurrent_hooks_path_present=1
\t\telse
\t\t\tstatus=$?
\t\t\tif [ "$status" -ne 1 ]; then
\t\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to inspect core.hooksPath before rollback' >&2
\t\t\t\treturn 1
\t\t\tfi
\t\t\tcurrent_hooks_path_present=0
\t\tfi
\t\tif [ "$current_hooks_path_present" -ne 1 ] || [ "$current_hooks_path" != "$managed_hooks_path" ]; then
\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: rollback preserved externally changed core.hooksPath' >&2
\t\t\treturn 1
\t\tfi
\t\tif [ "$initial_hooks_path_present" -eq 1 ]; then
\t\t\tif ! git -C "$repo_root" config --local core.hooksPath "$initial_hooks_path"; then
\t\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to restore previous core.hooksPath' >&2
\t\t\t\treturn 1
\t\t\tfi
\t\telse
\t\t\tgit -C "$repo_root" config --local --unset-all core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
\t\t\tif git -C "$repo_root" config --local --get-all core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1; then
\t\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to restore absent core.hooksPath baseline' >&2
\t\t\t\treturn 1
\t\t\tfi
\t\tfi
\tfi
''',
    1,
)
text = text.replace(
    '''\ttrap 'release_install_lock' EXIT HUP INT TERM
\treturn 0
''',
    '''\ttrap 'release_install_lock' EXIT
\ttrap 'release_install_lock; exit 129' HUP
\ttrap 'release_install_lock; exit 130' INT
\ttrap 'release_install_lock; exit 143' TERM
\treturn 0
''',
    1,
)
text = text.replace(
    '''\ttrap 'cleanup_snapshot_work; release_install_lock' EXIT HUP INT TERM
''',
    '''\ttrap 'cleanup_snapshot_work; release_install_lock' EXIT
\ttrap 'cleanup_snapshot_work; release_install_lock; exit 129' HUP
\ttrap 'cleanup_snapshot_work; release_install_lock; exit 130' INT
\ttrap 'cleanup_snapshot_work; release_install_lock; exit 143' TERM
''',
    1,
)
text = text.replace(
    '''\ttrap 'release_install_lock' EXIT HUP INT TERM
}
''',
    '''\ttrap 'release_install_lock' EXIT
\ttrap 'release_install_lock; exit 129' HUP
\ttrap 'release_install_lock; exit 130' INT
\ttrap 'release_install_lock; exit 143' TERM
}
''',
    1,
)
text = text.replace(
    '''\t\t\tif ! git -C "$repo_root" config --local core.hooksPath "$managed_hooks_path"; then
\t\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to recover pending managed hooks activation' >&2
\t\t\t\texit 1
\t\t\tfi
''',
    '''\t\t\tif ! git -C "$repo_root" config --local core.hooksPath "$managed_hooks_path"; then
\t\t\t\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to recover pending managed hooks activation' >&2
\t\t\t\texit 1
\t\t\tfi
\t\t\thooks_path_written=1
''',
    1,
)
text = text.replace(
    '''if ! git -C "$repo_root" config --local core.hooksPath "$managed_hooks_path"; then
\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to enable managed snapshot hooks; pending ownership state retained for recovery' >&2
\texit 1
fi
write_state "$managed_state"
''',
    '''if ! git -C "$repo_root" config --local core.hooksPath "$managed_hooks_path"; then
\tprintf '%s\\n' 'git hook: failed to enable managed snapshot hooks; pending ownership state retained for recovery' >&2
\texit 1
fi
hooks_path_written=1
write_state "$managed_state"

p = Path("tests/install_hook_ownership_smoke.sh")
text = p.read_text()
old = '''lock="$common/codex-worker-orchestrator/hooks-install.lock"
mkdir -p "$lock"
if sh "$helper" install "$repo" "$guard_bin" >"$tmp/install-lock.stdout" 2>"$tmp/install-lock.stderr"; then
\tprintf '%s\\n' 'concurrent hook installer unexpectedly bypassed activation lock' >&2
\texit 1
fi
grep -Fq 'another installer owns hook activation' "$tmp/install-lock.stderr"
rmdir "$lock"
sh "$helper" install "$repo" "$guard_bin"
assert_managed_hooks "$repo"
'''
new = '''lock="$common/codex-worker-orchestrator/hooks-install.lock"
mkdir -p "${lock%/*}"
printf '%s\\n' "$$" >"$lock"
if sh "$helper" install "$repo" "$guard_bin" >"$tmp/install-lock.stdout" 2>"$tmp/install-lock.stderr"; then
\tprintf '%s\\n' 'concurrent hook installer unexpectedly bypassed activation lock' >&2
\texit 1
fi
grep -Fq 'another installer owns hook activation' "$tmp/install-lock.stderr"
rm -f "$lock"
printf '%s\\n' 99999999 >"$lock"
sh "$helper" install "$repo" "$guard_bin"
assert_managed_hooks "$repo"
test ! -e "$lock"
'''
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("hook smoke lock block mismatch")
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(text)
